| [No stated goals beyond the README](goals.md#problem-flow-goals-undocumented) | foldkit-flow | The README intro and STATE.md describe what the library is; spec 0000 lists goals for the development lifecycle, not for the product. This model is the first written list of product goals. The operator must confirm which goals hold. |
| [No glossary for the graph terms](goals.md#problem-flow-no-glossary) | foldkit-flow | Terms come from xyflow and Foldkit and are used across README, specs and code. A glossary would fix their meaning. |
| [STATE says nothing is blocked](goals.md#problem-flow-state-blocked-nothing) | foldkit-flow | The plugin and Bun problems do not stop work today, so "nothing" may be right. But the file does not say they are known risks. The maintainer must decide how STATE.md reports risks that do not block. |
| [Keyboard users cannot create connections](goals.md#problem-flow-keyboard-connect-missing) | foldkit-flow | The PR README says keyboard connect is not built and asks whether a later spec should add it. Without it a keyboard-only user can move and delete nodes but not draw edges. |
| [The browser journey does not run in CI](goals.md#problem-flow-journey-not-in-ci) | foldkit-flow | The workflow comment says it has no journey step. PR #4 says the journey is not in CI. A regression in pointer or keyboard behaviour could merge without a failing check. |
| [Only Chromium and mouse input were tested](goals.md#problem-flow-browsers-untested) | foldkit-flow | PR #4 lists these runs as "not run". Support for other browsers is unknown, and no goal sets a target. |
| [Demand and users are not measured](goals.md#problem-flow-demand-unmeasured) | foldkit-flow | The library exists because the operator wants it (log line 48). I found no evidence of other users in the cited sources and did not search every place a measure could live. The organisation has the same gap. The operator must decide what evidence of demand would count. |
| [Details of the Foldkit offer are undecided](goals.md#problem-flow-upstream-terms-open) | foldkit-flow | STATE.md line 13 fixes the name and the condition (the API has settled). What "settled" means, the date and the licence header are not recorded. |
| [Workflow hardening is deferred](goals.md#problem-flow-deferred-workflow-questions) | foldkit-flow | Spec 0000 leaves these as open questions for the operator. The deferral matches studio and reebeat. |
| [The module-mocking lint rule has a gap](goals.md#problem-flow-lint-mocking-gap) | foldkit-flow | Spec 0001 records this in its round-2 revision as a lint gap to follow up. The code in PR #4 was changed to avoid mocks, but the rule is not fixed. |
| [No security, conduct or contributing files](goals.md#problem-flow-community-files) | foldkit-flow | A published library needs a way to report vulnerabilities and a conduct policy. The operator must decide the content. |
| [Foldkit declares Effect 4.0.0, the repo runs 4.1.0](goals.md#constraint-flow-effect-peer-mismatch) | foldkit-flow | The warnings stay until a Foldkit release lists 4.1. Tests, the build and a browser run pass on 4.1.0 now. The operator must decide when to upgrade. |
| [Supported browsers and input types](technical-components.md#req-flow-portability-browsers) | foldkit-flow | No source sets a support target. PR #4 lists Firefox, WebKit and touch as not run. The operator must set the target. |
